'''Belderone''', originally known as '''Vartholium''',<ref name="TEA" /> was the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located on the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]], Belderone had two inhabited [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

==History==
Known in the [[Pre-Republic era]] as Vartholium, Belderone first came to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] prominence as a possession of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], becoming one of the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

Belderone shared its name with the [[Belderone Contention]], a conflict that took place during the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]], in the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] brought the Belderone Contention to a violent end at the [[Battle of the Dandrian Ring]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In the millennia after the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]], Belderone hosted a cottage industry of treasure hunters that made the dangerous jumps in the direction of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] tried to [[Battle of Belderone|conquer]] the planet shortly before the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] to act as a fortress for the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], but were thwarted by Galactic Republic forces led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], did, however, manage to kill twenty-seven [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] attempting to evacuate the populace of Belderone, among them [[Flint Torul]], of whom the son [[Flint]] managed to figure among the survivors, and thousands of civilians aboard the evacuation ships.<ref name="US">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>

[[File:BattleOfBelderone-SWAnnual3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Battle of Belderone (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Belderone]] during the Galactic Civil War.]]
[[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] later assembled [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] on the planet, which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used to [[Battle of Belderone (Galactic Civil War)|destroy]] Flint's hometown. The death of Flint's mother led to him being seduced to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by Darth Vader and later becoming the Dark Lord of Belderone, apprenticed to [[Lumiya]]. Many refugees from Belderone fled to nearby [[Naldar]], but that world was [[Subjugation of Naldar|conquered]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] by Imperial forces led by Flint himself. However, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] managed to redeem Flint. Flint returned to Belderone to help his people rebuild.

Belderone and [[Kulthis]] both had [[Stenax]] colonies. The reason the Stenaxes colonized these planets is unknown. They remained isolated from the other inhabitants, on Belderone settling a previously uninhabited continent. Thankfully, they did not participate in the [[Stenax Massacres]].

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] eventually destroyed AT-AT facilities on Belderone.<ref name="TNEGtVaV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> After the defeat of [[Waru]] and the destruction of the star [[Crseih]], the New Republic sought to relocate the homeless [[Firrerreo/Legends|Firrerreos]], whose homeworld had been desolated by the Galactic Empire. The Firrerreos had been placed in suspended animation in slaveship by the Empire. Flint persuaded the [[Belderonian]]s to accept the Firrerreos on Belderone.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> However, rivalry between the two peoples arose. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] used this rivalry to their own ends, setting the Firrerreo and Belderonians against each other. Belderone, weakened by internal conflict, was then easily conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong, who enslaved the Belderonians and rendered the Firrerreo all but extinct.
